description: Output of rclip-rtf's own writer: four runs covering bold, a foreground colour, italic + underline + strike together, and a named font at 18pt on a background
notes: Generated by rclip-rtf::write, and pinned so a change in the writer's output shows up as a diff rather than only inside an assertion (tests/write.rs::the_written_fixtures_match_the_writer). Decodes to 'plain bold red italic underline strike Courier 18pt on yellow'. \fs36 is 18pt. The background is written as both \cb and \highlight because AppKit honours only the first and RichEdit only the second - verified against NSAttributedString(rtf:).
